plan.title: eRFX Items Drawer Rejects Negative Quantity

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the specified product to the pricing sheet.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Enter the invalid negative quantity directly into the quantity cell.
Assert that the sheet refuses -5 and marks the quantity cell as invalid.
